brand_summary: Stumptown Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster and retailer founded in Portland, Oregon, in 1999 [P1]. The company has a long-standing partnership with producers in Guatemala, building a Direct Trade model that continues to shape its operations [P3]. It has a dedicated Instagram and email marketing strategy, including a campaign called 'Huye Mountain' that highlights its commitment to organic coffee [P7].
